name: AI Input Selector
description: AI chat input with a model menu, a separate Effort control, file chips you can drop or paste, a / command menu, and Stop while replying.

name: AI Input Search
description: AI composer with a Tools menu (browse, investigate, draft, run code, reason), a model picker and a live trace that stacks each source's avatar as it is read.

name: AI State Loading
description: Agent progress as a list of steps with a live log, elapsed time and a summary when done.

name: AI Text Loading
description: AI thinking text with a soft wave through the letters and words that swap letter by letter.

name: AI Voice
description: Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send.

name: AI Tool Approval
description: Approve or deny an agent's tool calls. Destructive calls need a press and hold, and decided calls fold into a trace with their output.

name: AI Tool Calls
description: Tool calls inside a chat reply. Each call streams in as one row with a live timer, then they fold into a single line once the answer is ready.

name: AI Checkout
description: An order the assistant puts together, paid without leaving the chat. The button fills while the charge runs, then the card folds into a one-line receipt.

name: AI Connect
description: A tool call that stops because an app is not connected. Connect it right in the message, and the call picks up where it stopped.

name: AI Send
description: An email the assistant drafted, editable in place. Send starts a short countdown you can undo before anything goes out.

name: AI Schedule
description: Meeting times the assistant found, each with a strip of both calendars so you can see why it is free. Booking folds the list into the event.

name: AI Attachment
description: A file dropped into the chat uploads, then the assistant reads it page by page. Page citations in the answer light up the page they point at.

name: AI Code Run
description: The assistant runs a short Python script in the reply. A marker steps down the lines, the output prints, and the chart it draws grows in.

name: AI Order Status
description: A live delivery card in the reply. The courier moves along the route while the ETA counts down, and the route turns green on arrival.

name: AI Handoff
description: The assistant hands the chat to a person, with what they will see so you don't repeat yourself. The queue counts down and the agent joins the thread.

name: AI Context Meter
description: How full the context window is, as a ring in the prompt footer that opens a breakdown by source and compacts when it fills.

name: AI Inline Citations
description: An answer with source chips beside each claim. One preview glides between chips and lights up the sentence it backs.

name: AI Diff Review
description: A coding agent's edits streaming in file by file, then reviewed per file with accept, reject and undo.

name: AI Model Selector
description: Pick a model and how hard it thinks. Effort is a detent track that reshapes for each model and keeps your level when you switch.

name: AI Token Alternatives
description: An answer where every unsure word shows what else the model weighed. Pick another word and the reply writes itself again from there.

name: AI Conversation Branches
description: A chat where editing a message starts a new branch. A small tree beside it shows every version, and you can jump between them.

name: AI Agent Lanes
description: A lead agent hands work to sub-agents that run side by side. Each gets a lane of tool calls, and you can scrub through the whole run.

name: AI Inline Edit
description: Select text in a document and ask AI to rewrite it. The edit streams in place as a word-level diff you accept, discard or try again.

name: AI Message Queue
description: Keep typing while the agent works. Follow-ups stack above the composer, where you can reorder, edit or send one now, and go in one by one when the run ends.

name: AI Redact
description: Masks names, emails, card numbers and keys as placeholders before a prompt is sent, then fills the real values back into the reply.

name: AI Memory
description: An assistant that saves what it learns about you into a memory list. New facts replace the ones they contradict, and you can edit or forget any of them.

name: AI Autocomplete
description: A text box that suggests how your sentence ends in grey after the caret. Tab takes it all, the right arrow takes one word, and typing the same letters keeps it.

name: Slash Command Menu
description: A chat composer with slash commands, a hint bar that spells out each argument and a menu that offers values for it. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Image Generation Card
description: An AI image panel where Generate resolves the picture from coarse pixel blocks to sharp with a step counter, then four variations land. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Dot Field
description: A halftone dot membrane that ripples behind a swipe and rings out from a click, built with React and Canvas.

name: Background Paths
description: A ribbon of lines in one color that keeps flowing at any size and parts around the cursor.

name: Shape Hero
description: A landing hero where shapes drop in, pile up under the headline and can be grabbed and thrown.

name: Wind
description: Streamlines that part around the cursor, swirl in its wake and scatter on click, built with React and Canvas.

name: Topo Background
description: A living contour map that drifts, rises under the cursor and ripples on click, built with React and Canvas.

name: Drape Background
description: A pleated curtain in a breeze that you can push and pull, built with React, WebGL and a cloth simulation.

name: Halftone Background
description: Any image, or a lit sphere, printed as a halftone dot screen, with a loupe that looks closer under the cursor, built with React and canvas.

name: Ink Background
description: A hero written in ink on water. Stir it and the letters bleed, click to drop ink, and the headline gathers itself again. Built with WebGL.

name: Caustics Background
description: A hero on the floor of a pool. Light ripples across it, clicks drop rings that bend the light, and the headline's shadow wobbles below.

name: Rain Glass Background
description: A hero seen through a rainy window. Drops gather and run, each a tiny lens on the view, and dragging wipes the fog off the glass.

name: Rhythm Hero
description: A health and sleep app hero with hairline rings breathing a 4-7-8 cycle, a week of sleep-stage bars and calm stats. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Dither Reveal Hero
description: An image generation hero where a drawn scene resolves from coarse dither to full detail as the prompt types. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Flick Card
description: A two-sided card you spin with a drag or a flick, with thickness, light and a floor shadow that follow the angle.

name: Throw Deck
description: A pile of image cards you drag, flick off the top and send under the deck, with arrow keys and a details view.

name: Now Playing
description: Music card with a spinning disc you can grab and turn to scrub, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

name: Apple Activity Card
description: Activity rings that draw with a count-up, lap past 100% with a shadowed end cap and dim to focus, built with React and Motion.

name: Widget Grid
description: Dashboard widgets you lift, drag and resize on a 6-column grid, with spring physics and full keyboard support.

name: Currency Transfer
description: Transfer tracker that converts the amount in place, walks through each step on a filling rail and ends with a copyable reference.

name: Momentum Rail
description: A card rail you flick with momentum, snapping on a spring, with scroll-driven cover-flow depth and parallax.

name: Notification Stack
description: Stacked notifications that fan out on hover and swipe away, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

name: Liquid Gauge
description: A usage meter filled with liquid that sloshes, ripples and bubbles, built with React and a wave simulation.

name: Activity Terrain
description: A contribution heatmap that tilts up into a 3D terrain you can turn, built with React and canvas.

name: Page Flip
description: A book you turn by the corner. Drag a page over the spine or tap to turn it.

name: Receipt Printer
description: A receipt that prints line by line, then tears off and falls when you pull it, built with React.

name: Metric Card
description: A revenue KPI card. Scrub a day, drag a range, or pick a segment; the number rolls, the line morphs and the breakdown follows.

name: Uptime Card
description: A status page card with 90 days per service that swell under the cursor, and a day you click opens its incident log.

name: Spending Ring
description: A spending breakdown you spin like a dial; flick the ring and it settles with a category under the marker.

name: Boarding Pass
description: A boarding pass that keeps itself current. When the gate or times change, only the changed characters roll over, the old value struck through.

name: Lightbox Grid
description: A photo grid whose thumbnails grow into a full view and fly back to their slot when you drag them down.

name: Onboarding Checklist
description: A get-started checklist with a progress ring, steps that collapse as you check them and an all-set state at the end. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Split Nav
description: Navigation bar that splits around the active link, with drag-to-scrub, flick projection and an optional compact fold.

name: Tool Dock
description: An editor tool dock with a sliding selection plate, shortcut tooltips and flyouts that you can throw to any edge.

name: Swipe Tabs
description: Tabs with a swipeable panel, a drag-tracked indicator and spring physics.

name: Account Menu
description: An account card that morphs into its own menu, with account switching, status, theme and hold-to-sign-out.

name: Command Palette
description: ⌘K command palette with nested pages, fuzzy matching and in-row progress for running actions.

name: Smooth Drawer
description: Checkout bottom sheet on Vaul snap points, peeking at the total and dragging up for details.

name: Marking Menu
description: A radial menu you hold to open or flick to pick blind, built with React and Motion.

name: Scroll Index
description: A section rail for long pages, with a tick per heading that you can hover, click or drag to scrub, built with React.

name: Status Island
description: A pill that reports background work, reshaping as tasks change and opening into a list of everything in flight.

name: Stack Panel
description: A panel that drills into pages like settings on a phone. The tapped row's label flies up into the title, and a swipe right takes you back.

name: File Upload
description: A multi-file upload queue with per-file progress, retry and cancel.

name: Avatar Picker
description: Generated avatars from a name, morphing as you type, on a 3D coin you can flick, tap or shuffle.

name: Team Selector
description: Seat picker with a scrubbable number, generated avatars and an optional rolling price line.

name: Loader
description: Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

name: Detent Dial
description: Rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch and coasts when flicked, built with React and Motion.

name: Wheel Picker
description: iOS-style 3D drum picker with flick momentum, built with React and Motion.

name: Liquid Slider
description: A vertical slider you fill like a glass, with a sloshing surface and rising bubbles.

name: Signature Pad
description: A signature field with a sprung pen tip, speed-weighted ink and SVG output.

name: Time Zone Planner
description: Find a meeting time across time zones. Turn the meeting round a 24-hour dial where each ring is someone's day.

name: Amount Pad
description: A keypad for sending money. Digits spring into place, commas slide them along, and the amount shrinks to fit as it grows.

name: Seat Map
description: Pick seats for a show. Drag along a row to take several, and it points out any single seat you'd leave stranded.

name: Card Field
description: A one-row card input for checkout. The number groups the way the brand prints it, then slides to its last four to make room for expiry and CVC.

name: Stay Picker
description: A date range picker for booking stays. Every night shows its price, sold-out nights are hatched, and your stay is one pill that wraps across weeks.

name: Slot Picker
description: Book a meeting on a day rail. Drag a meeting into a free gap; it hops over existing bookings, resizes in place and shows the host's local time.

name: Tip Selector
description: A tip picker for checkout, set on a tape you drag and flick. The ticks you pass fill in, the amounts roll, and Round up makes the total a whole amount.

name: Location Picker
description: Set a pickup point the way ride apps do. Drag the map under a fixed pin; it lifts off its shadow, glides onto the nearest curb, drops, and the street rolls in.

name: Swatch Fan
description: A color picker shaped like a paint fan deck. Drag it open, pick a hue and a shade, and copy the hex. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Price Range
description: A two-handle price filter drawn over a histogram of the results, with a live count. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Clip Trimmer
description: A video trim timeline with a filmstrip, handles that snap to whole seconds and a playhead that loops the kept range.

name: Synced Transcript
description: A transcript that follows the spoken word, lets you click any word to jump there, and waits when you scroll away.

name: Focal Point Picker
description: Set where a photo's subject is and see every crop follow it live. Hover a crop to see what it cuts.

name: Photo Straighten
description: Level a crooked photo on a ruler you drag or flick. The crop grows to hide the corners, and a grid shows while you adjust.

name: Contact Sheet
description: Pick from a shoot the way photographers do. Circle a frame in china marker, click again to strike it, and look through a loupe at the detail first.

name: Audio Player Card
description: A podcast or voice note player with a scrubbable waveform, chapter tooltips and a speed chip. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Promise Toast
description: A toast that follows a task: the ring spins while it works, closes into a check or a warning when it lands, and offers Undo or Retry. Toasts stack, fan out on hover and swipe away.

name: Inline Alert
description: An alert that does something about the problem: it lists the failed checks, re-runs them one by one, and turns from red to green when they pass.

name: Save Status
description: An autosave pill for editors that says Editing, Saving or Saved, counts changes while offline, and syncs them when the connection comes back.

name: Empty State
description: An empty list that shows what is missing and turns into it: the card in the drawing becomes your first project, ready to rename.

name: Helpful Rating
description: A page rating whose face changes with each answer, then asks what went wrong or what helped, with quick reasons and an optional note.

name: Typing Text
description: Typewriter text that makes the odd typo and corrects it, erases by selecting, and blinks its caret only when idle, built with React and Motion.

name: Dynamic Text
description: Morphing text where shared letters travel, old ones fall and new ones land, with decode and cycle modes.

name: Glitch Text
description: Flat text that cuts into hard-shifted bands with a thin red/cyan split, on idle, hover or text change.

name: Extruded Text
description: Zinc 3D extruded text lit by your pointer, with letters that press in like keycaps.

name: Plucked Text
description: A headline sitting on a string you can pluck, strum and let ring, built with React and real string physics.

name: Cradle Text
description: A headline hung like a Newton's cradle, so a knock on one letter clacks through the word, built with React and pendulum physics.

name: Spoiler Text
description: Inline text hidden under drifting specks, like a chat spoiler. A click blows the specks away from the point you touched.

name: Marker Text
description: Hand-drawn highlights, underlines, circles, boxes and strikes that draw themselves in reading order when the text comes into view.

name: Shadow Text
description: A headline that works as a sundial. Each letter casts a long, soft shadow set by the reader's clock, and bringing the pointer close turns it into a lamp.

name: Split Flap Text
description: Departure-board lettering for headlines and status lines. Each tile flips only as far as its new letter, on a hinge, a beat after its neighbour.

name: Kinetic Type Hero
description: A studio hero where an edge-to-edge headline sets itself in and leans away from the cursor. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.

name: Particle Button
description: A status button for async actions, with a spinner, a drawn check and a particle burst on success.

name: V0 Button
description: Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

name: Gradient Button
description: Layered gradient button with emerald, purple and orange variants, a gradient border, a soft inner glow, press feedback and an optional icon.

name: Magnet Button
description: A call-to-action button wrapped in a field of iron filings that align to its magnetic field and lean toward your cursor.

name: Hold Button
description: Press and hold to confirm, with a fill that drains back on early release and a drawn check on completion.

name: Command Button
description: A button with its shortcut drawn as keycaps that sink as you press the real keys.

name: Switch Button
description: Light and dark theme toggle whose sun folds into a moon while the new theme spreads from the button as a circle.

name: Slide Text Button
description: Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS.

name: Pull Cord
description: A lamp switch you pull on a swinging cord, built with React and a rope simulation.

name: Tear Button
description: A confirm button you tear off like a ticket stub, hole by hole.

name: Bell Button
description: A subscribe button whose bell swings and rings, with a clapper that really strikes.

name: Morph Popover
description: A button that grows into the form it opens, with its label sliding up to become the title, then shrinks into a confirmation.

name: Undo Button
description: An action button that gives you a few seconds to take it back, with the time left drawn around its own edge.

name: Slide to Confirm
description: A confirm control for payments and other actions you can't take back. Slide the thumb to the end, or flick it.

name: Save Button
description: A bookmark button that files into collections. Tap to save to the last one, then change it or make a new one from the strip.

name: Cart Button
description: An Add button that opens into a quantity stepper in place, with a bin at one and press-and-hold to repeat.

name: Pay Button
description: The last button of a checkout, carrying the amount and the card it charges. Part of Kokonut UI Pro.
